episodes.synopsis: After being transported from Earth to Byston Well, Shou is told he will fight for Lord Drake Luft. Later, he is attacked and forced to consider who he is fighting for.
episodes.title: The Aura Battlers

episodes.synopsis: Shou accompanies Lord Drake's envoy to meet with the political enemy, Neal Givens, to negotiate for peace. However, Lord Drake has other plans.
episodes.title: Given's Mansion

episodes.synopsis: Shou and Elmelie discuss his role in Lord Drake's plan. Later, while the Aura Battlers are on patrol, Neal and his troops launch a surprise attack.
episodes.title: Escape from Laas Wau

episodes.synopsis: Lord Drake sends his troops to find Elmelie as she searches for Neal. Shou decides which side he wants to fight for.
episodes.title: Elmelie's Hardships

episodes.synopsis: Resentment starts to grow within Keen. As Shou chases after her, Lord Drake's troops begin to close in.
episodes.title: Keen in Danger

episodes.synopsis: Neal attempts to rendezvous with his father's forces. Todd has his orders to hunt down the Given's party.
episodes.title: Tragedy at the Forest of the Moon

episodes.synopsis: Despite the group's protests, Neal decides to go under cover to rescue Elmelie but quickly finds himself in trouble.
episodes.title: Night Before the Dawn of the War

episodes.synopsis: After Shou questions his and Marvel's place in Byston Well, he formulates a plan to go back home and finds that leaving is not as easy as it seems.
episodes.title: Laas Wau Once Again

episodes.synopsis: The group takes a dangerous a journey to Fairy Land to find allies for the upcoming civil war.
episodes.title: Earth and Sky

episodes.synopsis: After returning from Fairy Land, Keen and the others face an enemy they did not expect, leading to tragic consequences.
episodes.title: Father and Child

episodes.synopsis: After rejecting the king's offer of diplomacy, Lord Drake sends his troops to attack the castle while Shou and the others prepare for war.
episodes.title: Offense and Defense of Kiron Castle

episodes.synopsis: After Garalia and Todd discover the secret in King Foizon's armory, they launch a surprise attack that tests Shou's strength.
episodes.title: Garalia's Pursuit

episodes.synopsis: Todd is eager to prove himself after learning about the new recruits from Upper Earth but finds himself in a difficult situation.
episodes.title: Todd's Violent Advance

episodes.synopsis: Lord Drake launches an attack on Elf Castle and despite his advanced weaponry, his victory is not guaranteed.
episodes.title: Battle at Elf Castle

episodes.synopsis: Shou and others launch a surprise attack against Lord Drake. However, despite the promise of help, they are left on their own.
episodes.title: Furaon Moves Not

episodes.synopsis: After facing Garalia in battle, Shou and Cham find themselves in a familiar yet far away world.
episodes.title: Skies Over Tokyo

episodes.synopsis: Shou has a hard time proving who he truly is. Meanwhile, Garalia faces new enemies while she explores her surroundings.
episodes.title: The People of Upper Earth

episodes.synopsis: While Neal continues to fight against Lord Drake's forces, Shou faces a personal battle that leaves deep scars.
episodes.title: Flash of Garalia

episodes.synopsis: Shou finds himself mysteriously back in Byston Well. Meanwhile, Neal and the others find themselves under attack.
episodes.title: Battler Shou

episodes.synopsis: In a desperate attempt to prove his worth, Bern, in the latest battler, seeks to capture Shou.
episodes.title: Bern's Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: Elmelie escapes her father's castle in attempt to find Neal but is taken captive by bandits.
episodes.title: Fugitive Elmelie

episodes.synopsis: Elmelie's presence causes tension within the group. Thirsty to prove her loyalty, Elmelie begins taking risks, much to Neal's dismay.
episodes.title: Soldier: Elmelie Luft

episodes.synopsis: Muisy attempts to take Elmelie back to Lord Drake. However, Elmelie takes her fate into her own hands, even if it means disobeying a direct order.
episodes.title: Musiy's Pursuit

episodes.synopsis: Shou is surprised when he finds himself fighting a familiar enemy. During his battle, he discovers a mysterious world outside Byston Well.
episodes.title: Attack vs. Attack

episodes.synopsis: Braun and Todd join forces to bring Elmelie back to Lord Drake. As the two fight against Shou and Marvel, a new level of aura power is revealed.
episodes.title: Joint War

episodes.synopsis: After her mother is killed, Elle finds refuge with Shou. As Neal and the others fight against Lord Drake's forces, Elle reveals the extent of her spiritual powers.
episodes.title: Elle's Spiritual Powers

episodes.synopsis: Despite not knowing where he is, Shou manages to help rescue a princess who challenges his place in Byston Well.
episodes.title: Queen of the Red Storm

episodes.synopsis: Using Elle’s spiritual power, Shou and the others reunite with King Foizon to help stop Lord Drake’s advance. However, Elle senses something dark enveloping the king.
episodes.title: Goraon's Take-off

episodes.synopsis: Despite constant warnings, King Foizon leaps into battle. Shou’s Dunbine is greatly damaged during battle but receives unexpected help from an old friend.
episodes.title: Billbine Appears

episodes.synopsis: Shou heads back to Lord Drake’s castle to free the silkie trapped there. As he heads to safety, Shou and Marvel are transported back to the Fairy World.
episodes.title: The Silkie's Escape

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious foe ambushes Show and Marvel en route to the Land of Na. Is this Black Knight a harbinger of things to come?
episodes.title: The Omen of the Black Knight

episodes.synopsis: The denizens of Byston Well can no longer stand idly by and perform a ritual to protect the land.  What will this mean for those on both sides of the war?
episodes.title: Surfacing

episodes.synopsis: Show finds himself in familiar territory yet separated from his friends. Now, he must reunite with them and heads out towards Marvel’s last known coordinates.
episodes.title: Machine Expansion

episodes.synopsis: The displaced forces of Byston Well realize that their barriers give them an overwhelming advantage in battle.  The Zelana attempts to flee, but multiple enemies pursue.
episodes.title: Aura Barrier

episodes.synopsis: Out of desperation, Upper Earth unleashes nuclear weapons against the Byston Well invaders.  What can Show and his friends do to overcome this terrifying development?
episodes.title: Goraon's Scorching Heat

episodes.synopsis: Show and his friends decide to upgrade their systems with Upper Earth technology.  They travel to India to meet with a manufacturer, but the army is tracking their every move.
episodes.title: The Enemy Is Gea Gring

episodes.synopsis: Show and the others engage the Gea Gring in a fierce battle.  Elle has a sudden, ominous vision that warns of a far greater danger.
episodes.title: Hyper Jeril

episodes.synopsis: Marvel muses over the secret of Jeril’s power.  Meanwhile, multiple Upper Earth organizations sense an opportunity and open up negotiations with the invaders.
episodes.title: Time Bomb

episodes.synopsis: The American government discusses an ultimatum from the invaders while Show and his friends wonder which nation they should aid. Marvel is placed in dire peril during battle.
episodes.title: Bishott’s Prisoner

episodes.synopsis: The city of Paris burns under Bishott’s relentless onslaught, prompting the French government to send a message to Show and his friends requesting their aid.
episodes.title: Paris Blazes

episodes.synopsis: The team attempts to cope with the unexpected, tragic consequences of a recent battle, but are denied rest as the enemy quickly hones in.
episodes.title: Europe Front

episodes.synopsis: Bishott faces mounting resistance from Norway.  Worried over the safety of both Byston Well and Upper Earth, Elmelie plans her next move.
episodes.title: Insurrection of the People of Upper Earth

episodes.synopsis: Show and his friends discover that the Gea Gring is barreling towards London.  Wishing to defend their allies, they plan a daring ambush.  Will their plan succeed?
episodes.title: Hyper Show

episodes.synopsis: Ciela commands the Guran Galan to intercept and attack the Will Wipps.  The crew of the Zelana decides to join the fight as reinforcements.
episodes.title: Guran Attack

episodes.synopsis: The USS Carl Vinson goes rogue and allies itself with the Zelana to protect America.  Meanwhile, Drake and Todd strategize while Ellie formulates a plan of her own.
episodes.title: Beyond the Todd

episodes.synopsis: Muisy embarks on a  mission to assassinate Ciela under the guise of friendship.  Can Show and the others arrive in time to stop her?
episodes.title: Operation Remote Control

episodes.synopsis: Drake discovers Leeza’s betrayal through Elmelie.  The crew of the Zelana head into battle, but little do they know that they face the beginning of the end.
episodes.title: Drake Luft

episodes.synopsis: The battle intensifies as all sides are resolute in their determination.  The world watches with bated breath how the end will come.
episodes.title: Cross Fight

episodes.synopsis: There is only one way the war can end, and there can be no victory without sacrifice.  When the dust finally settles, who will remain standing?
episodes.title: Chum Huau
